standalone.purpose: Validate deterministic class, CTAN, template and Overleaf distribution candidates, checksums and package metadata.

dynamic_assets.purpose: Exercise the Arial branch of the Windows font proof-of-concept matrix.

dynamic_assets.purpose: Exercise the Times New Roman branch of the Windows font proof-of-concept matrix.

manual_control_roots.purpose: Provide the documented Windows preparation entrypoint for local Times New Roman and Arial TeX metrics, maps and font definition files.
manual_control_roots.reason: This pipeline is intentionally manual because it depends on locally installed proprietary Microsoft fonts; the entrypoint owns the two encoding-conversion PowerShell helpers transitively.

manual_control_roots.purpose: Own the exact-source four-locale matrix of 28 joined academic manuscripts and its fast negative/source preflight.
manual_control_roots.reason: The 28 real Biber/PDF profiles run as a dedicated parallel per-locale workflow, not as an implicit additional heavy check in every ordinary Linux integration iteration.

manual_control_roots.purpose: Prove optional class-owned labels and inherited module behavior in twelve PT/EN/ES/FR real PDFs including long tables, listings, algorithms and minted.
manual_control_roots.reason: Runs a dedicated four-locale parallel workflow with TeX Live and minted dependencies so regular Linux integration need not duplicate expensive optional PDF builds.
